findings.title: Data race on init counter
findings.body: In searchSupport.init totalBatchesIndexed++ executes concurrently in multiple errgroup goroutines limited by initWorkers with no atomic/mutex protection. This is a data race that corrupts the count reported in the 'namespaces indexed' span event and can be detected by -race. Use an atomic counter or collect results after group.Wait.

findings.title: Concurrent BuildIndex for same key can corrupt index
findings.body: The change removes the mutex covering the whole BuildIndex and only locks around the final cache store. Two concurrent builds for the same NamespacedResource (from init workers plus getOrCreateIndex/Search/watch paths) can now both call bleve.New on the same file directory, both run the builder, both increment IndexTenants metrics, and then last-writer-wins in the map, leaking the loser. There is no per-key singleflight/locking to prevent duplicate builds.

findings.title: TotalDocs reads cache map without lock
findings.body: TotalDocs iterates b.cache without holding cacheMu while BuildIndex writes b.cache[key] under Lock and GetIndex reads under RLock. With the new finer-grained locking builds run highly concurrently, so this is a concurrent map read/write race that can panic or corrupt. The read must hold RLock.

findings.title: Failed Init leaks server context
findings.body: NewResourceServer creates a cancelable context for the server, stores cancel in the server struct, then calls s.Init(ctx) synchronously. On Init error it returns nil, err without calling cancel, leaking the context and any resources started before the failure. Call cancel before returning the error.

findings.title: History/Origin panic when search disabled
findings.body: Search checks s.search == nil, but History calls s.search.History and Origin calls s.search.Origin unconditionally. When SearchOptions.Resources is nil (search disabled) these RPCs nil-dereference and panic the gRPC server. With lazy Init removed there is no other guard. Add the same nil check as Search.

findings.title: Postgres storage-server path skipped
findings.body: The test now skips whenever GRAFANA_TEST_DB is postgres, so the storage-server target with instrumentation server is never exercised on postgres in CI. Since the PR moves unified storage initialization to startup and changes lifecycle ordering, losing that coverage risks regressions on the postgres dialect going unnoticed.
